en: Vertically divided color postcard showing two views of the same large, ornate institutional building set behind fields and a fence. The architecture is late‑19th‑century European with white walls, red roof tiles, and decorative gables and pinnacles. The top image is a more distant view over ploughed fields, emphasizing the surrounding grounds and trees. The lower image is a closer street‑level view, showing a brick‑and‑iron fence, entrance gate, and a few small figures walking along the road in front of the main façade. No printed caption or legible text appears on the image side.
